items.stem: Which TWO are sound governance controls for AI in the close? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Maintain an audit trail of AI-assisted steps and human sign-off
options.rationale: Correct: traceability supports audit and accountability.

options.text: Avoid entering confidential data into uncontrolled tools
options.rationale: Correct: data privacy must be protected.

options.text: Let AI approve its own journal entries
Hide AI use from the auditors

options.rationale: Correct: flags are signals to investigate, not confirmed errors.

options.text: Ignore them all as false positives
options.rationale: Dismissing without review defeats the control.
